test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a straight line facing the north (but not necessarily in the same order). M is sitting to the immediate left of P. O is sitting to the immediate left of Q. R is sitting to the immediate right of P and the immediate left of L. N is sitting to the immediate right of L and the immediate left of O. Who is sitting second to the left of N?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a straight line facing the north

1) R is sitting to the immediate right of P and the immediate left of L. 

2) N is sitting to the immediate right of L and the immediate left of O.

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6de3a2d59d5e954b8937ac8cdf9b72170303fcdf2c80278c5edfb3d8a86adc5b.png] 

3) M is sitting to the immediate left of P.

As there is no possible position for M in case-1, therefore is eliminated.

Case 2)

4) O is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

As there is no possible position for Q in case-3, therefore is eliminated.

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06346caa439300d365fa953fe8d64cc696ccf25861d7ad36f52ca87a7229bd41.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement R is sitting second to the left of N.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
